text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Write(y, x) ::: y writes x.
FamilyHistory(x) ::: x is Family History.
CreatedBy(x, y) ::: x is created by y.
WrittenIn(x, y) ::: x is written in year y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
AmericanCity(x) ::: x is an American city.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
NovelWriter(x) ::: x is a novelist.
Premises:
¬Podcast(novel) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornIn(x, americanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, then they are American.
∀x (Novel(x) ∧ Write(y, x)) → NovelWriter(y) ::: If a book is a novel and written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
Write(DaniShapiro, FamilyHistory) ::: Dani Shapiro wrote Family History.
FamilyHistory(WrittenBy) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
FamilyHistory(WrittenIn, 2003) ::: Family History was written in 2003.
CreatedBy(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
City(Boston) ::: Boston is a city.
AmericanCity(Boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Premises:
DaniShapiro is an American writer.
FamilyHistory is a novel written in 2003.
Conclusion:
NovelWriter(DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is a novel writer.
